name: Ngoc Linh ginseng leaf salad
summary: The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names gỏi lá sâm Ngọc Linh among the Xơ Đăng dishes cooked at Tu Mơ Rông’s food festival in early 2023. A leaf list was not printed.
origin: The tourism authority says Tu Mơ Rông held an Xơ Đăng food festival in early 2023, for the province’s 110th anniversary, with 11 teams.
howToEat: The article names the salad and does not print a method or a price. Check on arrival.
where: Tu Mơ Rông, at that Xơ Đăng festival. It is not the Trần Cao Vân platter unless a kitchen tells you so. Check on arrival.
